### Bible Pathways 08/04/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-08-or-04-or-2002-1147168.html
Passage: Isaiah 17:3-10
Points:
- Both Israel and Judah faced destruction because they drifted into worldly pursuits and forgot the God of their salvation.
- Material prosperity and self-glory create a deceptive sense of security that blinds people to God's will.
- Covetous accumulation of wealth weakens spiritual faith and mimics the idolatry that brought judgment on ancient cities.
- Rather than trusting in fleeting riches, believers must place their security in God and dedicate resources toward eternal purposes.
